verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמ֑וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד יְהוָ֥ה חֲ֝קַרְתַּ֗נִי וַתֵּדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh ḥă·qar·ta·nî wat·tê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David O LORD You have searched me and known me

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣י וְקוּמִ֑י בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝רֵעִ֗י מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā šiḇ·tî wə·qū·mî ban·tāh lə·rê·‘î mê·rā·ḥō·wq
verses.literal: You know when I sit and when I rise You understand my thoughts from afar

verses.original: זֵרִ֑יתָ אָרְחִ֣י וְרִבְעִ֣י הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה׃ וְֽכָל־ דְּרָכַ֥י
verses.transliteration: zê·rî·ṯā ’ā·rə·ḥî wə·riḇ·‘î his·kan·tāh wə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵay
verses.literal: You search out my path and my lying down You are aware of all my ways

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין מִ֭לָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֑י הֵ֥ן יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃ יְ֝הוָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: kî ’ên mil·lāh bil·šō·w·nî hên yā·ḏa‘·tā ḵul·lāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Even . . . before a word is on my tongue . . . You know all about it O LORD

verses.original: צַרְתָּ֑נִי אָח֣וֹר וָקֶ֣דֶם וַתָּ֖שֶׁת כַּפֶּֽכָה׃ עָלַ֣י
verses.transliteration: ṣar·tā·nî ’ā·ḥō·wr wā·qe·ḏem wat·tā·šeṯ kap·pe·ḵāh ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: You hem me in behind and before You have laid Your hand upon me

verses.original: דַ֣עַת פִּלְאִיָּה מִמֶּ֑נִּי נִ֝שְׂגְּבָ֗ה לֹא־ א֥וּכַֽל לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḏa·‘aṯ pil·ʾī·yå̄h mim·men·nî niś·gə·ḇāh lō- ’ū·ḵal lāh
verses.literal: [Such] knowledge [is] too wonderful for me too lofty for me to attain

verses.original: אָ֭נָ֥ה אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵרוּחֶ֑ךָ וְ֝אָ֗נָה אֶבְרָֽח׃ מִפָּנֶ֥יךָ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nāh ’ê·lêḵ mê·rū·ḥe·ḵā wə·’ā·nāh ’eḇ·rāḥ mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit Where can I flee from Your presence

verses.original: אִם־ אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֭מַיִם אָ֑תָּה שָׁ֣ם וְאַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’es·saq šā·ma·yim ’āt·tāh šām wə·’aṣ·ṣî·‘āh šə·’ō·wl hin·ne·kā
verses.literal: If I ascend to the heavens You are there if I make my bed in Sheol You are there

verses.original: אֶשָּׂ֥א כַנְפֵי־ שָׁ֑חַר אֶ֝שְׁכְּנָ֗ה בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’eś·śā ḵan·p̄ê- šā·ḥar ’eš·kə·nāh bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ yām
verses.literal: If I rise on the wings of the dawn if I settle by the farthest sea

verses.original: גַּם־ שָׁ֭ם יָדְךָ֣ תַנְחֵ֑נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃ וְֽתֹאחֲזֵ֥נִי
verses.transliteration: ga·mō·šā- šām yā·ḏə·ḵā ṯan·ḥê·nî yə·mî·ne·ḵā wə·ṯō·ḥă·zê·nî
verses.literal: even there Your hand will guide me Your right hand will hold me fast

verses.original: וָ֭אֹמַר אַךְ־ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי א֣וֹר וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה בַּעֲדֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’aḵ- ḥō·šeḵ yə·šū·p̄ê·nî ’ō·wr wə·lay·lāh ba·‘ă·ḏê·nî
verses.literal: If I say Surely the darkness will hide me and the light become night around me

verses.original: גַּם־ חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹֽא־ יַחְשִׁ֪יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָ וְ֭לַיְלָה יָאִ֑יר כַּיּ֣וֹם כַּ֝חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּאוֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ḥō·šeḵ lō- yaḥ·šîḵ mim·me·ḵā wə·lay·lāh yā·’îr kay·yō·wm ka·ḥă·šê·ḵāh kā·’ō·w·rāh
verses.literal: even the darkness is not dark to You but the night shines like the day for darkness is as light to You

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה קָנִ֣יתָ כִלְיֹתָ֑י תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗נִי אִמִּֽי׃ בְּבֶ֣טֶן
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh qā·nî·ṯā ḵil·yō·ṯāy tə·suk·kê·nî ’im·mî bə·ḇe·ṭen
verses.literal: For You formed my inmost being You knit me together in my mother’s womb

verses.original: אֽוֹדְךָ֗ עַ֤ל כִּ֥י נוֹרָא֗וֹת נִ֫פְלֵ֥יתִי נִפְלָאִ֥ים מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יֹדַ֥עַת מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·wḏ·ḵā ‘al kî nō·w·rā·’ō·wṯ nip̄·lê·ṯî nip̄·lā·’îm ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā wə·nap̄·šî yō·ḏa·‘aṯ mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: I praise You for I am fearfully and wonderfully made Marvelous [are] Your works and I know this very well

verses.original: עָצְמִ֗י לֹא־ נִכְחַ֥ד מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָּ אֲשֶׁר־ עֻשֵּׂ֥יתִי בַסֵּ֑תֶר רֻ֝קַּ֗מְתִּי בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ṣə·mî lō- niḵ·ḥaḏ mim·me·kā ’ă·šer- ‘uś·śê·ṯî ḇas·sê·ṯer ruq·qam·tî bə·ṯaḥ·tî·yō·wṯ ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret when I was woven together in the depths of the earth

verses.original: עֵינֶ֗יךָ רָ֘א֤וּ גָּלְמִ֤י׀ כֻּלָּ֪ם יָמִ֥ים יִכָּ֫תֵ֥בוּ וְעַֽל־ סִפְרְךָ֮ יֻצָּ֑רוּ וְלֹא אֶחָ֣ד בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ne·ḵā rā·’ū gā·lə·mî kul·lām yā·mîm yik·kā·ṯê·ḇū wə·‘al- sip̄·rə·ḵā yuṣ·ṣā·rū wə·lō ’e·ḥāḏ bā·hem
verses.literal: Your eyes saw my unformed body all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me . . . before one of them came to be

verses.original: וְלִ֗י מַה־ יָּקְר֣וּ רֵעֶ֣יךָ אֵ֑ל מֶ֥ה עָ֝צְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lî mah- yā·qə·rū rê·‘e·ḵā ’êl meh ‘ā·ṣə·mū rā·šê·hem
verses.literal: How precious to me are Your thoughts O God how vast is their sum

verses.original: אֶ֭סְפְּרֵם יִרְבּ֑וּן מֵח֣וֹל הֱ֝קִיצֹ֗תִי וְעוֹדִ֥י עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’es·pə·rêm yir·būn mê·ḥō·wl hĕ·qî·ṣō·ṯî wə·‘ō·w·ḏî ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: [If] I were to count them they would outnumber the grains of sand and when I awake I am still with You

verses.original: אִם־ אֱל֥וֹהַּ׀ תִּקְטֹ֖ל רָשָׁ֑ע ס֣וּרוּ מֶֽנִּי׃ דָ֝מִ֗ים וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah tiq·ṭōl rā·šā‘ sū·rū men·nî ḏā·mîm wə·’an·šê
verses.literal: O God that You would slay the wicked away from me you bloodthirsty men

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹ֭אמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּ֑ה עָרֶֽיךָ׃ נָשֻׂ֖א לַשָּׁ֣וְא
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer yō·mə·ru·ḵā lim·zim·māh ‘ā·re·ḵā nā·śu laš·šāw
verses.literal: who speak of You deceitfully Your enemies take [Your name] in vain

verses.original: הֲלֽוֹא־ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ אֶשְׂנָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה׀ אֶתְקוֹטָֽט׃ וּ֝בִתְקוֹמְמֶ֗יךָ
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w- mə·śan·’e·ḵā ’eś·nā Yah·weh ’eṯ·qō·w·ṭāṭ ū·ḇiṯ·qō·wm·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Do I not hate those who hate You O LORD and detest those who rise against You

verses.original: שְׂנֵאתִ֑ים תַּכְלִ֣ית שִׂנְאָ֣ה הָ֣יוּ לְ֝אוֹיְבִ֗ים לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: śə·nê·ṯîm taḵ·lîṯ śin·’āh hā·yū lə·’ō·wy·ḇîm lî
verses.literal: I hate them with perfect hatred I count them as my enemies

verses.original: חָקְרֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל וְדַ֣ע לְבָבִ֑י בְּ֝חָנֵ֗נִי וְדַ֣ע שַׂרְעַפָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·qə·rê·nî ’êl wə·ḏa‘ lə·ḇā·ḇî bə·ḥā·nê·nî wə·ḏa‘ śar·‘ap·pāy
verses.literal: Search me O God and know my heart test me and know my concerns

verses.original: וּרְאֵ֗ה אִם־ עֹ֥צֶב דֶּֽרֶךְ־ בִּ֑י וּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·’êh ’im- ‘ō·ṣeḇ de·reḵ- bî ū·nə·ḥê·nî bə·ḏe·reḵ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: See if there is any offensive way in me lead me in the way everlasting
